body: WORKSTREAM_ID=ws-state-rd-angle-authority-20261001T231043Z. WORKSTREAM_STATE=COMPLETE. STARTING_MAIN_SHA=FINAL_MAIN_SHA=45bb0d326899c0e08415928224cfea0ff58d2d4e; MAIN_CHANGED_DURING_RND=NO. STRONGEST_PROVEN_FINDING: HingeAngleSource suppresses public hinge events while externalActive is fresh before retaining a fallback candidate; WallpaperAngleFeed later clears external authority on stale precise callbacks, but clearExternal emits/promotes nothing. Because the target fallback sensor may be on-change/coarse, the only current public event can be lost and geometry can remain stale until another physical hinge movement. Secondary finding: current session/poll identity does not bound source age; accepted precise callbacks restamp freshness at consumer receipt time. PROPOSED ARCHITECTURE: one control-thread Fold7AngleAuthority with immutable source/session/sequence/source-time envelopes; preserve existing session/poll checks; make source age part of precise lease validity; always retain latest fresh public candidate; promote it atomically on precise expiry/revocation; keep DeviceState wake-only; scope synthetic endpoints to exact precise session/generation; instrument authority/source-age transitions. Reduced model 11/11 including 100k deterministic adversarial events. The model's 96 ms lease is an R&D test value based on existing poll timeout, not a production tuning decision. No production GitHub writes. Fold7 device fault-injection validation remains required before integration/tuning.
